title: Contract Pricing Agreement Tier and the Commercial Credit Account Discount Rate
content:
On a Commercial Credit Account, the tier recorded on the customer's live Contract Pricing Agreement sets how much of the terms tier's prompt-payment discount percentage enters **the discount rate** of a catch-up prompt-payment discount on an invoice dated inside that agreement's current term, from its effective date through its expiration date. The live agreement is the customer's one agreement whose status is active or renewal pending.

### Clause

For a payment on such an invoice the contract share of the discount rate follows the tier recorded on the customer's live agreement, so an invoice dated inside that agreement's current term on a tier listed among the terms tier's cash-discount-excluded pricing tiers is net-priced and earns no discount. The contract share of the discount rate is nothing for a net-priced invoice, three quarters for an invoice dated inside the current term of a Corbett Category Contract or Corbett Volume Discount Agreement, and the whole rate otherwise. The share multiplies the terms tier's percentage.

The cash-discount-excluded pricing tiers are Corbett Net-Price Contract, Corbett Cost-Plus Contract and Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement on every terms tier.

### Schedule

| Tier recorded on the live Contract Pricing Agreement | Share of the terms tier's percentage |
|---|---|
| Corbett Net-Price Contract, Corbett Cost-Plus Contract or Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement (net-priced invoice) | nothing |
| Corbett Category Contract or Corbett Volume Discount Agreement | three quarters (75 percent) |
| any other tier, such as Corbett Account Price Schedule | the whole (100 percent) |

### Q&A

**The live agreement is a Corbett Volume Discount Agreement in renewal pending status, and the invoice is dated on its expiration date. What share applies?** The expiration date is inside the term, so three quarters (75 percent).

*Hypothetical rate:* on a 1 percent terms tier, an invoice inside the term of a Corbett Category Contract carries a share of 75 percent, a rate of 0.75 percent.
